notes: Per-scope Aliax accounts, storage and resolution: sessions.account_pin / account_current and projects/workspaces.account_pins (JSON, one per provider) with SessionMeta.accountPin/account and ProjectMeta/WorkspaceMeta.accountPins; accountRouting.ts resolves a thread's pin (thread > project > workspace, per provider; a child never inherits its parent's thread pin) and chooses the account a spawn names (a pin is always named with pin=1 so the gateway brings the thread back once it has room; otherwise the sticky current account while it has room, else the best pick for the model from the cache); WS methods session.account.pin, project.setAccounts and workspace.setAccounts. No driver or UI change yet.
